units.rhetorical_move: closes the harm with a duty
units.function: name the two failures, then say the repair deserves attention

features.clause_structure: cause then a duty clause
original_instantiations: An opening can grant the machine works and still call the repair a duty.
The duty phrase arrives before any stage of the chain is named.

units.source_excerpt: the creation and optimization of a good food system deserves our attention.
units.reusable_pattern: Grant the efficient machine, name the two harms, and close on a duty rather than a result.
prohibited_generalizations: do not treat a duty close as required in every summary

units.rhetorical_move: names three links, then a titled procedure
units.function: split the chain into three links and give the middle link a capitalized algorithm

features.clause_structure: list then a named procedure
original_instantiations: A summary can cut a chain into three stages and title only the middle procedure.
The titled procedure is allowed to be longer than the stage it serves.

units.source_excerpt: We abstracted the food system into three links: production, transportation and sales, and established models respectively.
units.reusable_pattern: Name the chain as three links, then give one link a long capitalized procedure name.
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse this paper's link names as a universal outline

units.rhetorical_move: drops the article in front of the indicator
units.function: say an indicator was established, and leave the article out

features.clause_structure: two indicators, both without an article
original_instantiations: A summary can announce a score and omit the determiner in front of the noun.
The same bare noun can be repeated for the second score in the next sentence.

units.source_excerpt: According to the proportion of people who are hungry in the sales process model, we have established equity indicator.
units.reusable_pattern: Announce a score with the determiner left out, then do the same for the next score.
prohibited_generalizations: a missing article here is this paper's habit, not a rule for every indicator sentence

units.rhetorical_move: parks a result, then a crop remark, then the sentence that was already underway
units.function: give the two countries their months, and let a crop sentence interrupt the weight sentence

features.clause_structure: country, month, land, hunger, then an interrupting crop
features.quantitative_role: the months and the land percents do the work
original_instantiations: A result sentence can be cut in half by a crop remark and then resumed.
The resumed half can be the clause that explains how a weight was computed.

units.source_excerpt: Beans are characterized by high calories and its planting area increased. At the same time, we gradually increased the priority of sustainability compared to equity
units.reusable_pattern: Let a crop remark break a result sentence, then pick the result sentence up again.
prohibited_generalizations: do not treat an interrupted summary sentence as a general results style

units.rhetorical_move: defines the system and never closes the parenthesis
units.function: define the chain, open a parenthesis for the inputs, and leave it open

features.clause_structure: definition, then an unclosed parenthesis
original_instantiations: A background can open a parenthesis for the inputs and never close it.
The figure caption can sit in the middle of that sentence.

units.source_excerpt: any inputs required at each step along the chain of activities, such as land, agricultural chemicals, labor, water, machinery, capital) and output.
units.reusable_pattern: Open the input list with a parenthesis and do not close it before the next clause.
prohibited_generalizations: an unclosed parenthesis is this page's slip, not a template

units.rhetorical_move: splices a hunger count into a moral turn
units.function: drop the count into a sentence that has already started somewhere else

features.clause_structure: a count welded to a purpose clause
original_instantiations: A count can be welded onto a purpose clause that began in another sentence.
The weld word can be a participle that pretends the count was the subject.

units.source_excerpt: Nations estimates that there are approximately 821 million hungry people in the world, implying that we will have to consider more factors besides the economy
units.reusable_pattern: Weld a published count to a purpose clause with a participle, even if the subject does not match.
prohibited_generalizations: do not copy this splice into a clean introduction

units.rhetorical_move: marks each task with an equals sign
units.function: list the four tasks as equals-sign bullets rather than numbers

features.clause_structure: four tasks, each opened by an equals sign
original_instantiations: A restatement can mark each task with an equals sign instead of a number.
The sign can sit where a bullet would have been.

units.source_excerpt: we need to solve the following problems:
units.reusable_pattern: Mark the task list with an equals sign at the start of each item.
prohibited_generalizations: an equals sign is this paper's bullet, not a standard task marker

units.rhetorical_move: leaves the verb in the base form after to
units.function: say the income was used to established the indicator

features.clause_structure: purpose clause with an uninflected verb
original_instantiations: A work summary can leave the verb after to in the base form.
The same sentence can still name whose income the score uses.

units.source_excerpt: we use income of farmers and transporters to established efficiency indicators.
units.reusable_pattern: Keep the verb after to in the base form, and still name the two incomes.
prohibited_generalizations: the base form is this paper's slip, not a pattern to copy

units.rhetorical_move: sets the inside haul to zero and collapses the carriers
units.function: justify one zone by setting its inside cost to zero and merging its carriers

features.clause_structure: justification after the arrow assumption
original_instantiations: An assumption can price the inside of a zone at zero and then merge everyone in it.
The merge can turn many carriers into one carrier for that zone.

units.source_excerpt: We assume that the transportation cost of food in the same living area is 0.
units.reusable_pattern: Price movement inside the zone at zero, then treat every carrier there as one carrier.
prohibited_generalizations: a zero inside cost is this model's convenience, not a fact about regions

units.rhetorical_move: freezes the price for a month
units.function: refuse a finer clock because people see a stable price for a while

features.clause_structure: claim, then a life-scale justification
original_instantiations: A clock assumption can say a finer step would be too hard to estimate.
The life-scale reason can be that a price stays put for a stretch of ordinary time.

units.source_excerpt: The market price of the same food is unchanged in the same month.
units.reusable_pattern: Freeze the price for one month, and justify it by ordinary stability rather than by data.
prohibited_generalizations: a monthly freeze is this paper's clock, not a required time step

units.rhetorical_move: declares the data true
units.function: assume the offices' figures are true, and say that is enough to simulate

features.clause_structure: assumption stated as a fact about the data
original_instantiations: A data assumption can simply call the figures true and reliable.
The justification can be that the simulation needs them to be so.

units.source_excerpt: Assume the research data is true and reliable.
units.reusable_pattern: Call the source figures true, and give the simulation as the reason.
prohibited_generalizations: calling data true is not a check

units.rhetorical_move: points at a table whose symbols the extract smashed
units.function: announce the table, and let the symbol column fail to print

features.clause_structure: one sentence pointing at a two-column table
original_instantiations: A notation section can be one sentence plus a two-column table.
The symbol column can fail to survive the extract while the descriptions remain.

units.source_excerpt: The key mathematical notations used in this paper are listed in Table 1.
units.reusable_pattern: Point at the table in one sentence, and accept that the symbol column may not print.
prohibited_generalizations: a smashed symbol column is an extract failure, not the authors' wording

units.rhetorical_move: switches region to area inside one profit row
units.function: define a profit from a region to an area in the same row

features.clause_structure: one row with two place words
original_instantiations: One notation row can start with a region and finish with an area.
The two place words can name the same kind of zone.

units.source_excerpt: the profit of the transporter buying food in region and selling food in area in month
units.reusable_pattern: Let one row buy in a region and sell in an area, without saying they differ.
prohibited_generalizations: the two place words are this table's slip, not two different partitions

units.rhetorical_move: borrows the three sources from Wikipedia
units.function: cite a general page, then say the three sources match most people

features.clause_structure: citation then a world claim
original_instantiations: A source list can be borrowed from a general page and then called typical.
The figure of three blobs can stand in for the argument.

units.source_excerpt: Refer to Wikipedia, the food sources of a country's food system include plantation sources, animal husbandry sources and fishery sources
units.reusable_pattern: Borrow a three-part list from a general page, then say it matches most people.
prohibited_generalizations: a general-page citation is this paper's source, not a data audit

units.rhetorical_move: adds three unlike yields and then multiplies
units.function: call meat, eggs, and milk the foods, and speak of a number of breeding

features.clause_structure: restriction then a definition
original_instantiations: A production line can add three unlike yields and then multiply by a headcount.
The headcount can be named as a number of breeding.

units.source_excerpt: Here, we only consider meat, eggs, and milk from animal husbandry as food sources.
units.reusable_pattern: Restrict the herd to three products, and name the headcount as a number of breeding.
prohibited_generalizations: adding the three yields is a defect of this line, not a general herd identity

units.rhetorical_move: calls catching a form of aquaculture
units.function: explain a high-latitude diet, then say catching happens through aquaculture

features.clause_structure: example, then a definition that mixes two methods
original_instantiations: A source paragraph can mix catching with a farmed method in one clause.
The industry can then be named with the other industry's second word.

units.source_excerpt: It mainly includes catching fish through aquaculture.
units.reusable_pattern: Define the catch as something done through a farmed method, then borrow the other industry's noun.
prohibited_generalizations: fishery husbandry is this section's blend, not a real sector name

units.section: 4.2 Food Calorie Model Based on Correction
units.rhetorical_move: points at Table 1 while the caption says Table 2
units.function: set rice per 100 grams to the benchmark 1, and cite the wrong table number

features.clause_structure: benchmark, then a misnumbered table
original_instantiations: A correction can set one food's ratio to 1 and scale every other food against it.
The prose can cite a table number the caption does not use.

units.source_excerpt: In this paper, the calorie per 100 grams of rice is used as the benchmark value 1
units.reusable_pattern: Set one food's ratio to 1, and let the prose cite a table number the caption does not use.
prohibited_generalizations: the rice benchmark is this table's choice, not a standard calorie unit

units.section: 5.2.2 Calculation of The Total Revenue of The Carrier
units.rhetorical_move: says the carrier moves one good, then sums every good
units.function: use a singular verb, double the period, and still sum over foods

features.clause_structure: a singular verb and a doubled period
original_instantiations: A cost sentence can keep a singular verb with a plural subject.
The same sentence can end a symbol's gloss with two periods.

units.source_excerpt: In general, the transporter only transport one type of goods at a time
units.reusable_pattern: Keep the verb singular, and let a gloss end with two periods.
prohibited_generalizations: the singular verb is this page's agreement slip, not a style to copy

units.rhetorical_move: says the algorithm simulates the simulation
units.function: double the verb, and close the section with as is follows

features.clause_structure: a doubled verb, then a broken lead-in
original_instantiations: A procedure can say that it simulates a simulation.
The lead-in to the steps can be as is follows rather than as follows.

units.source_excerpt: the algorithm simulates the simulation scenario of food transportation
units.reusable_pattern: Double the verb, and introduce the steps with as is follows.
prohibited_generalizations: the doubled verb is this algorithm's tic, not a template

units.rhetorical_move: calls food the necessities and capitalizes Population
units.function: treat a plural subject as singular, and capitalize the hungry group

features.clause_structure: a singular verb on a plural subject, then a capitalized common noun
original_instantiations: A demand sentence can give a plural subject a singular verb.
The hungry group can be capitalized as if it were a name.

units.source_excerpt: Food is the necessities of life for residents.
units.reusable_pattern: Give the plural subject a singular verb, and capitalize the hungry group.
prohibited_generalizations: the capitalized group is this page's slip, not a defined population class

units.rhetorical_move: attributes the definition to Mrs. Brent
units.function: quote the famous line and give it to the wrong name

features.clause_structure: a quotation hung on the wrong name
original_instantiations: A definition can be hung on a nearly-right famous name.
The quotation can still be the familiar needs-and-future sentence.

units.source_excerpt: Sustainable development, as Mrs. Brent famously said, it is "development that not only satisfies the needs of contemporary people, but does not endanger the ability of future generations to meet their needs."
units.reusable_pattern: Hang a familiar quotation on a nearly-right name, and keep the extra it is.
prohibited_generalizations: Mrs. Brent is this paper's miss, not the person who said the line

units.rhetorical_move: glues the country to the colon
units.function: choose two countries and leave no space before the first name

features.clause_structure: a purpose clause, then a glued name
original_instantiations: A case opening can glue the first name to the colon.
The zone can be declared equal to a province in the next paragraph.

units.source_excerpt: we chose two typical countries to apply our model :India and France.
units.reusable_pattern: Glue the first country to the colon, and set the zone equal to a province.
prohibited_generalizations: the missing space is this line's slip, not a caption style

units.rhetorical_move: reads a small flow as an infrastructure story
units.function: say the inflow is small, then blame roads, and call the other country's flow mostly negative

features.clause_structure: observation, then a because
features.quantitative_role: the sign of the net flow does the work
original_instantiations: A result can treat a small flow as evidence that the roads are poor.
The other country can be mostly negative and then be explained as exports.

units.source_excerpt: It can be seen that India's food calorie inflow and outflow are significantly less (compared to the huge food production).
units.reusable_pattern: Read a small flow as a road problem, and a negative flow as exports.
prohibited_generalizations: the road story is this paper's reading, not a measured freight cost

units.rhetorical_move: puts the hungry south-east next to a port and a mountain range
units.function: speculate, then name a port, then a mountain range

features.clause_structure: speculation, place, then terrain
original_instantiations: A map reading can name a port as the reason food leaves.
A mountain range can be the reason the same food does not come back.

units.source_excerpt: We believe that this is because it is close to Marseille, an important export port in France.
units.reusable_pattern: Explain a hungry pocket by a nearby port, then by a mountain range.
prohibited_generalizations: the port story is a speculation on this page, not a trade result

units.rhetorical_move: gives the two land moves and the two hunger drops
units.function: small base, then a large drop, and free people from hunger

features.clause_structure: two countries, land then hunger
features.quantitative_role: the percents and the counts are the result
original_instantiations: A result can pair a small land cut with a large land rise.
The hunger drop can be told as people freed, after the counts.

units.source_excerpt: For India, as the optimization proceeds, the land area has increased to a certain extent, increasing by 11.1%.
units.reusable_pattern: Pair a small land cut with a larger land rise, then give the hunger counts.
prohibited_generalizations: these percents belong to this run, not to a general country contrast

units.rhetorical_move: calls the table two counties and the time a need to spend
units.function: miss the country word, and noun the time

features.clause_structure: a caption error, then a noun phrase for time
features.quantitative_role: the parameter table is the evidence
original_instantiations: A caption can swap the last letter and say counties.
The time discussion can be titled as the time need to spend.

units.source_excerpt: Table 5: Model parameter change in two counties
units.reusable_pattern: Let the caption say counties, and title the clock as a need to spend.
prohibited_generalizations: counties is this caption's typo, not a second geography

units.rhetorical_move: says the drop occurred, and says the developing case falls faster
units.function: misspell the verb, and reverse the summary's comparison

features.clause_structure: a misspelled verb, then a comparison
original_instantiations: A cost sentence can misspell the verb that locates the turn.
The same paragraph can say the developing case falls faster than the summary said.

units.source_excerpt: At the same time, according to our model, they occured in the 19th and 29th months respectively.
units.reusable_pattern: Misspell the verb that dates the turn, and let the comparison reverse the summary.
prohibited_generalizations: the reversed comparison is a conflict to keep, not a result to average

units.rhetorical_move: says the three links identify the links
units.function: repeat the link word as the thing the split achieved

features.clause_structure: a black-circle item that repeats its noun
original_instantiations: A strength item can say the split identifies the very links it split.
The item can stay one sentence under a black circle.

units.source_excerpt: We model the food system separately according to the production, transportation, and sale links, and more fully identify the key links of the food system.
units.reusable_pattern: Claim the split identifies the links the split was made of.
prohibited_generalizations: repeating the noun is this list's cadence, not a stronger claim

units.rhetorical_move: calls the simulation close to real life
units.function: end the strength on reference significance

features.clause_structure: a simulation claim, then a hedge
original_instantiations: A strength can say the play is close to ordinary life.
The hedge can be a certain reference significance rather than a measured fit.

units.source_excerpt: which is close to real life and has certain reference significance.
units.reusable_pattern: Call the play close to ordinary life, and hedge it as a certain reference value.
prohibited_generalizations: reference significance is this paper's hedge, not a validation

units.rhetorical_move: blames the province on data reasons
units.function: admit the zone is a province, and give data as the reason

features.clause_structure: admission then a data excuse
original_instantiations: A limit can admit the zone was drawn for the data, not for the roads.
The harm can be named as accuracy, without a number.

units.source_excerpt: we regard each province as a living area for data reasons, which affects the simulation accuracy to a certain extent.
units.reusable_pattern: Admit the zone was chosen for the data, and name the harm as accuracy.
prohibited_generalizations: the province zone is this paper's limit, not a recommended scale

units.rhetorical_move: measures distance as a straight line
units.function: say the distance ignores the ground

features.clause_structure: a measurement, then the thing it ignores
original_instantiations: A limit can say the distance is a straight line.
The missing thing can be the ground, named in the same clause.

units.source_excerpt: The distance between different living areas is measured by straight-line distance, without considering the actual terrain factors.
units.reusable_pattern: Say the distance is straight, and name the ground in the same clause.
prohibited_generalizations: a straight-line distance is this paper's shortcut, not a road network

units.rhetorical_move: refuses a single model, then slips the verb
units.function: say the chain needs three models, and ask how long it occur

features.clause_structure: a refusal, then a bare verb
original_instantiations: A conclusion can refuse a single model and demand the chain be split.
The time question can leave the verb uninflected.

units.source_excerpt: In summary, the food system is not a system that can be simply measured by a single model.
units.reusable_pattern: Refuse a single model, and leave the time verb uninflected.
prohibited_generalizations: the bare verb is this close's slip, not a concluding cadence

units.rhetorical_move: says the move to a special country needed a correction
units.function: claim the migration worked, then admit a special case was corrected

features.clause_structure: a success claim, then a correction
original_instantiations: A close can say the move worked and then admit one hard case was patched.
The patch can be named as a correction rather than a new model.

units.source_excerpt: Moving to some special countries, we made some corrections.
units.reusable_pattern: Say the move worked, then admit one hard case was patched.
prohibited_generalizations: the patch is this country's terrain note, not a general fix

units.rhetorical_move: numbers six lines and quotes the addresses
units.function: give each source a number and wrap the address in single quotes

features.clause_structure: a numbered list with quoted addresses
original_instantiations: A reference list can wrap each address in single quotes.
The same numbers can be reused in the body for a different shelf.

units.source_excerpt: [1] The 2021 Food Systems Summit, United Nations, 2020.
units.reusable_pattern: Number each source and wrap the address in single quotes.
prohibited_generalizations: these six lines are this paper's shelf and should not be reused as a pattern id
